name: yunovideo
description: Yunovídeo — a small, offline SPA (Vite + Yuneta gobj-ui declarative shell) that reads the videos on your device and plays them from a queue you curate. Folders are authorised once and remembered; no file is copied and no file leaves the device. Every video remembers where you left it.

scripts.prebuild: npm run validate-locales && npm run check-markup
